front: In Amazon EC2, a batch job can stop and restart from a checkpoint at any time. Which purchasing option costs least?
extra: AWS recommends Spot for [stateless, fault-tolerant, flexible applications](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-spot-recommended-stateless-fault-tolerant-flexible).

front: In Amazon EC2, does a Savings Plan reserve capacity for your instances?
back: No. Use an On-Demand Capacity Reservation.
extra: [Savings Plans do not provide a capacity reservation](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-faq-savings-plans-no-capacity-reservation). An On-Demand Capacity Reservation holds the capacity.

front: In Amazon EC2, Dedicated Host or Dedicated Instance: which one shows sockets and physical cores for licensing?
extra: A Dedicated Host shows [the number of sockets and physical cores](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-dedicated-host-socket-core-visibility). A Dedicated Instance gives [no visibility](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-dedicated-host-socket-core-visibility).

front: In Amazon EC2, stop or reboot: which one keeps the data on instance store volumes?
extra: After a reboot [the data is preserved](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-state-diff-instance-store-data). After a stop, a hibernate or a terminate [the data is erased](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-state-diff-instance-store-data).

front: In Amazon EC2, can you turn on hibernation for an instance that is already running?
back: No. Only when you launch it.
extra: You turn on hibernation [when you launch it](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-hibernate-enable-only-at-launch). You [can't enable hibernation on an existing instance](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-hibernate-enable-only-at-launch).

front: In Amazon EC2, a few critical instances must not fail together. Which placement group do you use?
extra: In a spread placement group the instances are [each placed on distinct hardware](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-placement-spread-critical-instances), which [reduces the risk of simultaneous failures](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-placement-spread-critical-instances).

front: In Amazon EC2, a Spot Instance gets {{c1::two minutes of notice}} before Amazon EC2 interrupts it.
In Amazon EC2, Spot Instances run at a discount of {{c1::up to 90%}} compared with On-Demand prices.
In Amazon EC2, you buy a Reserved Instance for a {{c1::one-year or three-year commitment}}.
In Amazon EC2, On-Demand Instances are billed per second, with a {{c1::60-second minimum}}.
In Amazon EC2, an instance can stay hibernated for at most {{c1::60 days}}.
In Amazon EC2, a Linux instance cannot hibernate if it has more than {{c1::150 GiB}} of RAM.
In Amazon EC2, a rack-level spread placement group supports at most {{c1::seven running instances in each Availability Zone}}.
In Amazon EC2, a partition placement group supports a {{c1::maximum of seven partitions per Availability Zone}}.
In Amazon EC2, HPC nodes need the lowest network latency between them. Which placement group do you use?
extra: A cluster placement group suits applications that need [low network latency, high network throughput, or both](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-placement-cluster-recommended-traffic-between-instances).

front: In Amazon EC2, a large Cassandra cluster must keep its replicas on distinct racks. Which placement group do you use?
extra: Partition placement groups hold [large distributed and replicated workloads](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-placement-partition-distributed-workloads).

front: In Amazon EC2, can you move a network interface to an instance in another Availability Zone?
back: No. Only within the same Availability Zone.
extra: You attach a network interface to instances [in the same Availability Zone](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-eni-attributes-follow-same-az).

front: In Amazon EC2, can you change the instance type of a running EBS-backed instance?
extra: [You must stop your instance](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-resize-must-stop-instance) before you change its type, so you [plan for downtime](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-resize-must-stop-instance).

front: In Amazon EC2, admins need a shell with no inbound port and no SSH keys. What do you use?
extra: Session Manager gives access [without the need to open inbound ports](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-session-manager-no-inbound-ports-bastion-keys).

front: In Amazon EC2, can you launch an instance in another Region from your AMI directly?
back: No. Copy the AMI to that Region first.
extra: [AMIs are Region-specific resources](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-ami-region-specific-copy), so you [copy it from the source Region](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-ami-region-specific-copy) to the target Region.

front: In Amazon EC2, a workload needs high CPU all day. A burstable T instance, or an M or C instance?
back: An M or C instance, with dedicated CPU.
extra: If workloads [consistently require CPU usage much higher](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-faq-burstable-sustained-high-cpu-use-m-or-c) than the baseline, AWS says to [consider dedicated CPU instances](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-faq-burstable-sustained-high-cpu-use-m-or-c).

front: In Amazon EC2, system or instance status check: which failure needs AWS to repair it?
extra: System status checks find problems that [require AWS involvement to repair](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-status-check-system-needs-aws).

front: In Amazon EC2, regional or zonal Reserved Instance: which one reserves capacity?
extra: [A zonal Reserved Instance reserves capacity](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-ri-capacity-reservation-zonal-only) in its Availability Zone. [A regional Reserved Instance does not reserve capacity](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-ri-capacity-reservation-zonal-only).

front: In Amazon EC2, Standard or Convertible Reserved Instance: which one can be exchanged during the term?
extra: A Convertible Reserved Instance [can be exchanged during the term](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-ri-convertible-exchange-standard-not) for another Convertible Reserved Instance.

front: In Savings Plans, Compute or EC2 Instance Savings Plans: which one also covers Fargate and Lambda?
extra: Compute Savings Plans [also cover Fargate and Lambda usage](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-savings-plans-two-ec2-types-flexibility).

front: In Amazon EC2 Spot, which allocation strategy does AWS recommend?
extra: The strategy picks [the most-available Spot capacity pools](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-spot-price-capacity-optimized-recommended) that also have the lowest possible price.

front: In Amazon EC2, can you turn on termination protection for a Spot Instance?
extra: [You can't enable termination protection for Spot Instances](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-spot-no-termination-protection), so [you must be prepared for interruptions](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-spot-no-termination-protection).

front: In Amazon EC2, can you hibernate an instance that is in an Auto Scaling group?
back: No. Use a hibernated warm pool instead.
extra: [You can't hibernate an instance](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-hibernate-not-in-auto-scaling-group) that is in an [Auto Scaling group or used by Amazon ECS](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-hibernate-not-in-auto-scaling-group). A hibernated warm pool instance can [save the contents of your RAM](../facts/ec2-auto-scaling.md#ec2-auto-scaling-warm-pool-hibernated-ram).

front: In AWS compute, a container job runs longer than 15 minutes, with no servers to manage. Lambda or Fargate?
extra: A Lambda function runs for at most [15 minutes](../facts/lambda.md#lambda-faq-timeout-15-minutes). Consider Fargate for [specific resource needs or persistent processes](../facts/lambda.md#lambda-choose-fargate-containers-persistent).

front: In Amazon EC2, can you resize an instance to a type with another processor architecture and keep its AMI?
back: No. The architecture must stay the same.
extra: [AMIs are specific to the architecture](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-resize-same-processor-architecture), so the new type needs [the same processor architecture](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-resize-same-processor-architecture).

front: In Amazon EC2, an instance fails its system status check. Which CloudWatch alarm action fits?
extra: The recover action is [suited for System Health Check failures](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-alarm-reboot-instance-check-recover-system-check).

front: In Amazon EC2, stop or hibernate: which one keeps the contents of RAM?
extra: Hibernate keeps [the RAM data persisted](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-faq-hibernate-vs-stop-ram). On a stop, the [RAM is cleared](../facts/ec2.md#ec2-faq-hibernate-vs-stop-ram).
